messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: How do I file a complaint with the state?\nassistant: To file a complaint with the New York State Attorney General, you can visit their official website and select the category that best fits your purpose. For consumer issues, you can choose from categories like goods or services purchase, credit cards, credit reports, and personal finance, social media, personal data and information privacy, vehicle lease or purchase, and lemon law. If you cannot complete the form online or need additional assistance, you can call their OAG Help Line at 1-800-771-7755. Please note that patterns of complaints often help in allocating law enforcement resources, and filing a false complaint is punishable as a Class A Misdemeanor.\nuser: what if I want to file a complaint with other states\nassistant: The information I have does not provide an answer for other states except California, where you can file a complaint online. The whistleblower hotline is 1-800-649-7570, and the Department of Managed Health Care Help Center is 1-888-466-2219.\nuser: what is NY and CA office hours?\nassistant: The New York State Attorney General's Offices are open from 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. In contrast, the California Department of Consumer Affairs' Consumer Service Representatives are available to answer consumer, licensee, and applicant questions in over 200 different languages by phone from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, except on the first and third Wednesday of each month, when they open at 8:30 a.m., and on state-observed holidays.\nuser: if I work with New York State Attorney General office, who am I going to work with?\nassistant: The question is not clear enough. You need to say the position you will have so that I can tell you who you will work with. \nuser: can you please tell me more about Letitia James?",
    "answer": "Letitia James is the 67th Attorney General of the State of New York. She serves as the state’s chief lawyer and law enforcement officer. The provided information does not include further biographical details."
}
Output:

statements: Letitia James is the 67th Attorney General of the State of New York.
Letitia James serves as the chief lawyer of the State of New York.
Letitia James serves as the chief law enforcement officer of the State of New York.
The provided information does not include further biographical details about Letitia James.
